resources.name: pycalphad (open-source CALPHAD Python library)
resources.notes: Provides the computational engine for solving phase equilibria from thermodynamic databases.

resources.name: Fe-Ni thermodynamic database (SGTE-compatible TDB or FEDEMO)

access.package: pycalphad (bundled FEDEMO database or downloadable SGTE sources)

resources.notes: Gibbs free energy description for α (BCC_A2) and γ (FCC_A1) phases in Fe-Ni. The required thermodynamic parameters (interaction parameters, lattice stabilities, magnetic contributions) are standard and publicly documented. Molar volume data for pressure correction is included in the calculation.
